learning_outcomes: Advanced data structures and algorithms for manipulation in C++ with an emphasis on design and implementation, practical applications, and algorithms for sorting and searching.
Students will learn and understand the concepts and applications of basic and advanced C++ topics.
Students will learn the problem solving process and describe their solution to a computational problem in pseudocode and outline of solutions.
Students will apply the above skills to develop medium sized C++ projects to solve real-world problems.
Students will learn to analyze the time complexity of foundational algorithms.
Students will be comfortable performing unit-tests on C++ programs.
